title: Compactly supported direct image of towers is computed levelwise
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Write $\ell=u\varpi_E^e$ with $u$ a unit and $e\geq1$, so $R_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n=A_{E,en}$. Use the varying-coefficient tower category and its derived evaluations of [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian]. Let $c=(j,p)$ be a compactification $f=pj:X\to Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and define $F_f=Rp_{*,\bullet}j_{!,\bullet}$ on $D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(X,\mathcal O_E))$. Then:

1. There is a natural comparison $(F_fC)_n\simeq Rp_{*,R_n}j_{!,R_n}C_n=Rf_{!,R_n}^{c}C_n$ for every bounded-below tower complex $C$.
2. The following specified operations and maps exist in the ordinary derived categories of varying-coefficient towers and evaluate to the finite operations and maps. Tensor means derived tensor over the ring system $(R_{n,T})_n$; no completed tensor or condensed coefficient identification is meant.
   (a) In the global field setting $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_{p_0}$, $\ell\ne p_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], let $f$ be a morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes. For bounded-below towers $K$ on $X$ and $L$ on $Y$ whose levels are pro-etale realizations of bounded constructible finite-Tor complexes, with specified etale-origin witnesses at each level [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], the compactification projection map
   $F_fK\otimes^L_{R_{\bullet,Y}}L\longrightarrow F_f(K\otimes^L_{R_{\bullet,X}}f^{-1}L)$
   is an isomorphism. Both $K_n$ and $L_n$ are required to satisfy the finite-Tor hypothesis. The formula is formed in the ambient unbounded tower derived category using the total derived operations; on the bounded-below domain $F_f$ is the functor above.
   (b) For a cartesian compact-support square [def-cbc-compact-support-square], with separated finite-type $f$, arbitrary $g:Y'\to Y$, and compactification $c'=(j',p')$ obtained by base change from $c$, the specified exchange
   $g^{-1}F_fC\longrightarrow F_{f'}g'^{-1}C$
   is an isomorphism for $C\in D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(X,\mathcal O_E))$ whose every level has an etale-origin witness. There is no requirement that the chosen witnesses themselves be a compatible tower.
   (c) For a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ with complementary quasi-compact open immersion $a:U\hookrightarrow T$, and every $C\in D^+(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$, the open counit and closed unit fit into a distinguished triangle
   $a_{!,\bullet}a^{-1}C\to C\to i_{*,\bullet}i^{-1}C\to a_{!,\bullet}a^{-1}C[1]$.
   This evaluates to the finite open–closed triangle. The exact immersion operations in this formula are applied termwise. On schemes where $\ell$ is invertible, the same evaluation assertions include tensoring with specified coefficient-twist towers, that is, towers whose levels are the finite Tate twists with their quotient transitions [def-coefficient-twists-detailed].
3. A morphism in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(T,\mathcal O_E))$ is an isomorphism if and only if all its derived evaluations are isomorphisms. This assertion is for the unbounded ordinary derived category and asserts conservativity, not faithfulness or existence of lifts of arbitrary families of derived maps.

proof.text: Obtain b,o,x and the normalized finite and bounded-below comparison data from strictCompactificationComparisonRealization. The shared interfaces live in def-sp-tower-shriek-data to avoid an import cycle. The injective-components and coefficient-tower constructions remain used through this existing realization theorem.

Exact open extension maps D+ into D+. Apply the ordinary unbounded/rightDerivedFunctorPlus compatibility to the pushforward of that bounded-below object. Its image has a lower bound by definition of D+; transport that bound through the canonical compatibility isomorphism.

Joint conservativity is precisely Data.detects of the published semilinear calculus b.calculus T. The converse follows because evaluation is a functor and therefore preserves isomorphisms. This proves the unbounded detects field, not any faithfulness assertion.

At each n use finite_level_projection_criterion on both GoodLevel inputs and their retained origins. The tower projection evaluation equation identifies evaluation of the tower map followed by comparison isomorphisms with a composite of isomorphisms. Cancel those comparisons, then apply joint conservativity.

Apply tower_exchange_laws to the same normalized word comparisons and finite exchange comparisons. This residual supplies precisely the exchange field, independently of projection and localization. Combine it with the proved boundedness and detection and the other residual clauses into Laws.
Apply tower_localization_realization to each complementary closed/open pair. Combine boundedness, projection, exchange, localization and detection into the existing Laws structure for the same b,o,x.
